_description:
Safe-launch preset for Anthropic Claude Code CLI (Bun binary). This preset only grants the working directory — add the rest explicitly per invocation, since they depend on your setup:

- Config: redirect Claude's config out of the real ~/.claude, so the sandbox never needs access to it (it holds session history, memory, and other projects' data, not just this run's config), and allow only the redirected path: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR="$PWD/.claude-sandboxed" shadictl --policy policies/presets/claude.json --allow "$PWD/.claude-sandboxed" -- claude
  If you'd rather share your real Claude Code state into the sandbox instead, drop CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and add: --allow ~/.claude --allow ~/.claude.json
- Binary install location, if the Bun binary or its data live outside the read paths below: --allow ~/.local/bin --allow ~/.local/share/claude
- Windows: --allow %LOCALAPPDATA%\claude --allow %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\claude
